cohort: 100 patients aged 20-50 years with a gestational age >32 weeks, divided into two groups: those with five or more C-sections (n=50) and those with less than five C-sections (n=50).
finding: Patients with five or more C-sections had a higher risk of maternal and neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was higher in the group with five or more C-sections.
